# Independent holdout photo sources

These eight pinned NASA Image and Video Library assets are reserved for the mask-refinement
holdout corpus. None of their `source_group` values appears in the development corpus used to
select the Florence-2 candidate IoU threshold.

`manifest.json` records the official record page, exact asset URL, credit, usage terms and
SHA-256 digest. The repository derives deterministic 720×480 clean/watermarked pairs; originals
remain unchanged here. No asset contains user data or a project secret.
